criteria.notes: Recognition wall: studio identity, honouree name, discipline and role labels, citation, closing quote, and progress through the set. Paging passes the shared pagination conformance suite: every honouree appears exactly once per cycle, no page is empty, and a full cycle returns to the first page.
Editorial mosaic concept retained: primary colour blocks paired with portrait photography, serif names against sans labels.
Reads as a curated recognition wall rather than a people directory; the tile mosaic and per-tile colour assignment are concept-specific.
Honouree names and citations reach their intended sizes now that auto-fit resolves, so the hero tile no longer renders at its floor.
Dark-theme scenario keeps the colour tiles and their black or white text within readable contrast against the darkened field.
Long-copy and odd-count scenarios wrap citations completely; no ellipsis and no clipped quote line.
Tiles now fill the mosaic including the hero tile, whose previously empty lower area was the auto-fit floor collapse. Empty and single-person states substitute intentional compositions.
Portrait photography renders with an intentional fit; the missing-and-broken-photos scenario substitutes a monogram tile rather than leaving a gap.
The colour-blocked photographic mosaic is distinct from the table, panel and dashboard examples.
